searchText: EIPIP Meeting 52 Date and Time: Wednesday, Mar 23, 2022, at 15:00 UTC Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum-cat-herders/EIPIP/issues/116 Reminder: EIPIP meeting starting in ~1 hr (Starting in 10 mins) Join Zoom Meeting https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82357016731?pwd=V0hLUWIvU2V2UTdUd216WHdGNFBKUT09 <@!543900561460822016> <@!683653554631868440> <@!425279588009246720> ☝️ if you can make it. <@!642887713246150666> Next meeting is what date/time (UTC)? Based on the survey, there was a tie for 14:00 UTC and 14:30 UTC. Considering 14:00 UTC is being practiced as a standard time for other meetings. There is a general consensus for 14:00 UTC. So, the next meeting is scheduled for Apr 06, 2022 at 14:00 UTC I have reset what I think is the last wrong clock, in the kitchen, where I enjoy my coffee not knowing I'm an hour late 😦 I hate DST.
